title: Pyramid Transition Matrix
timeComplexity: ~(L^n) , L = maximum count of top characters available for each pairs in allowed, n = bottom.length()
spaceComplexity: O(n^2) recursion stack can go at most n levels deep, and at each level you keep a partially built row of length ≤ n, so the total stack memory is O(n × n) = O(n²).
